claims.text: Animate the supplied photo with slow drifting motion.
The image is a vertical multi-panel character reference sheet with a rainy hero panel, a three-view turnaround row, and four detail crops.
The hero panel shows a man in a black high-collared tactical outfit standing on wet reflective pavement at night as rain falls, with railings, city lights, and an illuminated building.
Fine rain streaks drift diagonally, wet reflections shiver, and the figure's jacket hem and small topknot stir faintly.
Soft steady rain ambience, faint fabric rustle, and subtle water ripples accompany the motion.

description.text: The complete vertical character-reference sheet remains present in its original layout: the large rainy hero panel at top, the FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK turnaround row in the middle, and the FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS detail row at the bottom. Inside the hero panel, fine rain streaks begin to drift diagonally through the cool blue-gray night, and warm amber reflections shiver across the wet pavement, metal railings, and illuminated building. The man in the black high-collared tactical jacket holds his three-quarter stance while the jacket hem and small topknot stir faintly. The turnaround and detail panels keep their plain charcoal backdrops and quiet held poses, with existing borders and labels fixed in place. The motion starts as a gentle, continuous drift that leaves the sheet's composition intact.
The complete reference sheet is held in its supplied arrangement, all panels and labels intact.
Soft steady rain ambience begins, with a faint fabric rustle.
Rain streaks drift diagonally and wet reflections waver in the hero panel.
A subtle water ripple supports the drifting motion.

The rain in the hero panel thickens into finer, faster drifting streaks, and puddles ripple under shifting warm amber and cool blue-gray reflections. The wet metal railings and distant city lights shimmer as the downpour combs across the scene, while the man's dark jacket and gathered hair move only subtly with his steady breathing. In the turnaround row, the front, profile, and back views retain their arms-at-the-sides poses with the faintest rise and fall; the studio backdrops stay clean, still, and evenly shadowed. Every panel, border, and existing label remains fully visible and locked to its place as the sheet's internal weather grows more active. The detail crops keep their close, quiet studies of face, collar, hands, and boots.
Rain intensifies slightly with soft water ripples.
Puddles catch shifting amber and blue-gray reflections.
The turnaround figures breathe subtly while holding their poses.
Faint fabric movement accompanies the steady rain.

The drifting rain eases into a last scatter of drops, and the wet reflections settle back toward stillness in the hero panel. The man's jacket and hair come to rest in the original three-quarter stance, and the front, side, back, face, collar, hands, and boots studies return to their quiet held poses. Residual droplets slide from the railings, faint ripples fade across the pavement, and the warm amber and cool blue-gray highlights soften without changing the sheet's layout. The full reference sheet remains visible, with all panels, borders, and existing labels intact as the motion calms to a gentle close. The final stillness preserves the complete supplied image.
Rain fades to a light patter.
Jacket hem and topknot come to rest.
